fresh_process.meaning: one new child process against a fresh artifact path containing byte-identical pinned inputs
fresh_process.not_a_claim: OS, executable, solver, and tool caches are not controlled

repeat_process.meaning: one new child process against a repeat artifact path containing the same pinned inputs
repeat_process.not_a_claim: a repeat process does not expose an incremental-recheck counter

required_operator_artifacts: pinned executable version or identity receipt

unavailable.cold_cache: no pinned CLI supplies page-cache, executable-cache, solver-cache, or tool-cache isolation
unavailable.incremental_cache_work: Bend supplies no incremental route and the reviewed SEMAPRAX public CLI supplies no changed-module reuse counter

nonclaims: no comparison between distinct proof routes
no proof of artifact byte equality until an executed receipt binds it
